text: まよい　さまよう　ゆうれいの　しょうたいは…　われわれでも　つかめない！

structure.jp: まよい　さまよう　ゆうれいの

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まよい　さまよう　ゆうれい
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. まよい さまよう ゆうれい = 'ghosts that are lost and wander'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a person or thing means 'even' that one. われわれでも = 'even we'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つかむ to つかめる turns 'grasp' into 'can grasp', and ない makes it 'cannot'. つかめない = 'cannot grasp'.
